solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: 'Enigma' to be broadcast — I will knock out a sign

indicators.note: broadcasting scatters something widely, so the letters of the word Enigma are spread into a new order
the letter I takes the place of the A it knocks out of the fodder, a swap of one letter for another

explanation.surface: A puzzle is to be aired on radio, and someone vows to remove a signpost.
explanation.walkthrough: In ENIGMA the I 'will knock out' A, giving ENIGMI, and 'to be broadcast' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Twins is one of the twelve zodiac signs of astrology.

clue.text: First-class fish on the decline

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI in crosswords
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A top-quality fish is on its way down.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sickening, whose health is getting worse, is on the decline.

clue.text: Penned acid needy letters about national celebration

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are turned about into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone writes sharp, needy letters concerning a national holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fourth of July, or any nation's anniversary of self-rule, is a national celebration.

clue.text: Beast's outspoken answer to 'Which wine, darling?'

definitions.note: the clue reads Beast is, so the definition is the beast

indicators.note: spoken out loud, so the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: the reply would be red, dear: the colour of wine and an endearment

explanation.surface: A creature's spoken reply to a partner asking what wine to pour.
explanation.definitionFit: This large deer of Britain and Europe is a wild animal, a beast in the old sense.

clue.text: Two creatures sheltering hospital cat turning up in overhanging growth

parts.note: the walrus is a tusked marine mammal

indicators.note: the second creature shelters the other pieces by holding them inside it

parts.note: a mouse is a small rodent

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the word cat from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
H is the abbreviation for hospital on road signs

explanation.surface: Two animals hide a hospital cat that appears in some shaggy whiskers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two creatures' supplies both animals at once; 'turning up' suits a down clue, where cat is read upwards as TAC.
explanation.definitionFit: This bushy whisker style droops over the upper lip, a growth hanging over the mouth.

clue.text: To lose one's footing wearing boots perhaps is careless

parts.note: to slip is to lose one's footing
shod means wearing shoes or boots

explanation.surface: Falling over while wearing boots is a sign of carelessness.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapdash, sloppy work done without care is careless.

clue.text: Gush about a jam lover

indicators.note: the word for gush goes round the other pieces, as about can mean surrounding

parts.note: to gush is to pour out
to jam is to ram, push forcefully

explanation.surface: Someone gushes over a pot of jam they adore.
explanation.definitionFit: An illicit lover, a mistress or suitor, is the old romantic word used here.

clue.text: Newspaper boss backed intended contempt

indicators.note: backed means turned backwards, so the boss's abbreviation is read in reverse

parts.note: ED is short for editor, the boss of a newspaper
your intended is the person you are engaged to

explanation.surface: An editor was supported by a planned show of scorn.
explanation.definitionFit: Open disregard or bold refusal to obey is a form of contempt.

clue.text: At sea most of cargo enters astern

indicators.note: the shortened cargo enters, goes inside, the word for astern

parts.note: aft means at or towards the stern

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a load is cargo carried by a vehicle or ship

explanation.surface: Almost all the freight is going in at the back of a ship at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that is floating on the water is at sea.

clue.text: Pulse indicated allergy to some extent

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the two words are used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A heartbeat showed a partial allergic reaction.
explanation.definitionFit: Lentils, split peas and other pulses are cooked as this Indian dish and ingredient.

clue.text: Not in agreement about November's bonus

indicators.note: the word for disagreeing goes about, around, the letter for November

parts.note: people who are divided do not agree
N is November in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: Arguments arise over a bonus payment due in November.
explanation.definitionFit: A share of profit paid out to shareholders is a bonus on their investment.

clue.text: First pair of reporters favourite to cover area in Echo

indicators.note: the first pair means the first two letters of the word reporters
the word for favourite covers, goes round, the abbreviation for area

parts.note: a pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: Two leading journalists cover a favourite topic in the local paper.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo is a sound coming again, a repeat of what was said.

clue.text: Available relations taking coach for Harrow or elsewhere

parts.note: single means unattached, available for romance
sexual relations, sex
to school someone is to coach them

explanation.surface: Unattached people find a partner and a trainer at a famous school.
explanation.walkthrough: Harrow is a famous English private school for boys only, hence the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Harrow educates boys only, so it is an example of an institution teaching one gender.

clue.text: Find fault with hack

definitions.meaning: a hack is a tired old horse

explanation.definitionFit: To carp at someone is to pester them; a broken-down horse is the other meaning.

clue.text: Daughter's poor exam result bringing disgrace

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter
an E grade is a low mark in an exam

explanation.surface: A girl's bad mark in her test brings shame on the family.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring someone down in esteem or shame them is to disgrace them.

clue.text: Delegate with messy air, disorientated

indicators.note: lost and confused, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An envoy with untidy looks has lost their bearings.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoy sent to represent others is a delegate.

clue.text: Hancock character — one with expression of disappointment — in funny drama

indicators.note: the other pieces go in the rearranged letters
funny means odd, so the letters of drama are put in an odd order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
oh is a sigh of disappointment

explanation.surface: A comic character, one sighing with letdown, appears in an amusing play.
explanation.walkthrough: Tony Hancock was a British comedian; 'The Radio Ham' is a famous 1961 episode of his show.
explanation.definitionFit: Hancock played an amateur wireless enthusiast in a famous comedy episode.

clue.text: Showing his age, old comic Ken familiarly embraces Queen

indicators.note: the comedian's nickname embraces, holds inside, the letters for the queen

parts.note: Ken Dodd, the late Liverpool comedian, was known familiarly as Doddy
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: The aging comedian Ken Dodd hugs the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaky and tottering with age describes someone showing their years.

clue.text: Aim to get goal

explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean the objective one is trying to reach, an intended purpose.

clue.text: Obliquely question expert about the capital of Norway

parts.note: to question is to ask

indicators.note: the word for expert goes about, around, the initial of Norway

parts.note: an ace is an expert

indicators.note: the capital letter, the first letter, of the word Norway

explanation.surface: Questioning a specialist on the Norwegian capital, but in a roundabout way.
explanation.definitionFit: To look sideways, with suspicion, is to look with a slanting or oblique glance.

clue.text: Be polite, be aware of your place initially, then employ abrasive questions

parts.note: to mind is to be aware of or attend to
one's is the impersonal form of your

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word place

parts.note: to sand is to use an abrasive such as sandpaper
Q is short for question, so QS for questions

explanation.surface: Etiquette advice: be courteous, know your station, then ask harsh questions.
explanation.definitionFit: Minding your manners, watching your letters P and Q, is an idiom for behaving politely.

clue.text: Lack of volunteers to join railway — official

parts.note: no TA: the Territorial Army is Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: No reservists sign up to work on the railway, says an official.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal officer who certifies documents and witnesses signatures is an official.

clue.text: Mini designer holds Issigonis's original — it's charmingly old-fashioned

indicators.note: the designer's name holds the original letter inside it

parts.note: Mary Quant designed the miniskirt

indicators.note: original means the first letter of the name Issigonis

explanation.surface: The Mini's creator Alec Issigonis made a car of quaint old-world appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: Issigonis designed the Mini car, but here the Mini is the miniskirt of Mary Quant, the British fashion designer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something attractively unusual or old-world in style is described this way.

clue.text: A pump possibly collecting last of water on land

indicators.note: the footwear collects, takes in, the final letter

parts.note: a pump is a kind of light shoe

indicators.note: last of means the final letter of the word water

explanation.surface: A water pump draws up the last drops on dry ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Off the boat and onto the coast means being on land.

clue.text: Visitors who want to be superior to their hosts

definitions.text: Visitors who want to be superior to their hosts

parts.words: Visitors who want to be superior to their hosts
parts.note: reads like rude houseguests, but means a sports side playing at the opponents' ground hoping to beat them

explanation.definitionFit: The visiting side in a sports fixture wants to beat the home team who host them.

clue.text: Horse manure's no good

indicators.note: with no good means the letter for good is removed

parts.note: dung is manure; the 's reads as is

explanation.surface: Horse droppings are useless.
explanation.definitionFit: A greyish-brown horse is called by this colour name.

clue.text: Following English runs, R. Bopara finally volunteers for slips

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
the initial R, as in Ravi Bopara's name

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of the name Bopara

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: After England's runs, Ravi Bopara at last offers to field at slip.
explanation.walkthrough: Ravi Bopara is an England cricketer; slips are close fielders in cricket, but here they are mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of printing mistakes, corrected slips, is given in a book this way.

clue.text: Love having her little bit of money around — that's easy to understand

indicators.note: the coin goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a cent is a small coin
love is nil in tennis, the letter O
taken as written

explanation.surface: Love and her small change go around, and it all makes sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Clear and logical speech or argument is lucid, easy to follow.
